spans.text: "conclusion": State your final conclusion based on the experiment you conducted, grounded in the results from your code execution. Provide a general relationship or concrete metrics that answers the research question (e.g., numerical improvement, performance gap, statistical significance, etc.).
spans.note: The prompt explicitly restricts the system from reading the paper itself, prevents using README to obtain results that should be derived experimentally, and requires conclusions to be grounded in actual code execution results.
